testimonials.name: Earline M.
testimonials.quote: My guardian angel came to the rescue. We had to go through probate because Mom passed, then my brother passed. Watson came into the house with gloves, sat down and started looking for the will. He even picked me up to bring me down to sign the papers. Talking about somebody really there for you — he's a good brother.
testimonials.shortQuote: My guardian angel came to the rescue. Talking about somebody really there for you — he's a good brother.
testimonials.outcome: Closed Sept 2023 · Inherited probate rowhome · Referred by a friend

testimonials.name: Jacqueline S.
testimonials.quote: My husband lived in that house since he was 12. He inherited it from his mother, then I inherited it from him. The repairs were just too much for me. Watson was patient, he was attentive to what I wanted, and he wasn't rushing me. He even covered gas money when I needed to get to closing. A very humble man, good at what he does.
testimonials.shortQuote: Watson was patient. He was attentive. He wasn't rushing me. A very humble man, good at what he does.
testimonials.outcome: Closed July 2023 · Inherited husband's family home · Found us on Google
